interventions.title: Deploy Anti-Smog Gun & Wet Sweeping
interventions.rationale: Elevated PM10 readings due to heavy unpaved shoulder dust and bus movement.
interventions.evidence: PM10 concentration 280 ug/m3; Anand Vihar CAAQMS shows Poor category.
interventions.notes: Water misting truck scheduled for twice-daily runs between 7 AM and 3 PM.
interventions.verification_method: GPS track logs from water tanker and hourly CAAQMS PM10 trend comparison.

interventions.title: Shift Morning Physical Assembly to Indoor Auditorium
interventions.rationale: AQI exceeding 220 (Poor) during morning inversion peak (7:30 - 9:00 AM).
interventions.evidence: Morning particulate peak recorded at 245 AQI; health advisory for pediatric respiratory protection.
interventions.notes: Indoor air purifiers operating in gym and auditorium; sports sessions postponed to post-noon.
interventions.verification_method: Daily log verified by school administration; parent notification dispatched.
